notes.subject: kɛmɛdoro wolonwula ni o ni nrɔnkɛmɛ ni saba
notes.rationale: jateden census yerɛ: 743 mɔgɔ minnu bɛ yɛlɛma walasa ka segin Yerushalayim.

notes.subject: קרית ערים
notes.rationale: Masaba (KJV/ASV) bɛ a jira ko Kiryat-Arim, nka 1 Kalandaw 9:17 bɛ sɛbɛn Kiryat-Yealim (Kirjath-Jearim) — Beherew (Beeroth) ni Giva (Gibeon) ka dɔgɔcogo bɛ Yosuwe 9:17 kɔnɔ.

notes.subject: ka denw
notes.rationale: Heburukan bɛ fɔ 'mɔgɔ minnu bɛ bɔ ... na' ; Bamanankan ka sɔrɔ 'denw' walima 'mɔgɔw' — denw la a bɛ kɛ 'denw' ye.

translation: Kiryat-Arim (Kiriyat-Yealim), Kefira ni Bewɛrɔ ka denw: kɛmɛdoro wolonwula ni o ni nrɔnkɛmɛ ni saba.
